title: Homemade Ketchup
description: A simple recipe for homemade ketchup, made without unwanted sugars and preservatives.
steps: Combine tomato paste, honey, water, sugar, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and white vinegar in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for about 20 minutes, or until reduced.
Pour the cooled mixture into a container.
notes:
The author states that refrigerating the ketchup will cause it to thicken more. They also mention that this recipe is made without unwanted sugars and preservatives found in store-bought ketchup. The author found this tasted better than store-bought ketchup.
